g.text: Laya isn't great out of the box. A few minutes of training on your laptop fixes that.
Brier on lab 10's held-out questions (real run)
# 1. Travel questions that share nothing with lab 10
# 2. The teacher labels them (its probability, not just yes/no)
# 3. Laya learns to give the teacher's probabilities
# 4. Before and after, on lab 10's questions
Measured on an Apple M4 Max.
